title: SM-16.14 - Are Member State ministries considered EU institutions for EUSurvey transition
intent: This article answers: SM-16.14 - Are Member State ministries considered EU institutions for EUSurvey transition
short_answer: No. For this transition, Member State ministries, national authorities, regional authorities and public corporations are considered external users. They will not be able to create new surveys themselves on the Commission-hosted EUSurvey service after 31 August 2026.
important_conditions: They may still participate in surveys, access public surveys and results where enabled, and manage surveys created by an EU institutional user when permissions are granted.
